meta.title: Sophonisbe, yelli-s n ugellid i yefran tamettant
meta.desc: Yelli-s n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon, tameṭṭut n Syphax syen n Masinissa, Sophonisbe tesw ssem di 203 uq.Ɛ. wala ad tcebbeḥ Triyunf n Scipion.
hero.title: Sophonisbe
hero.lede: Yelli-s n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon, tagellidt n Numidie snat n tikkal deg kra n iseggasen : tudert-is tella d sebba n tdiblumasit tapunikt deg umennuɣ apunik wis sin — tamettant-is, d yiwen n ugdil.
hero.alt: Tamettant n Sophonisbe, sɣur Mattia Preti
hero.caption: Mattia Preti, Tamettant n Sophonisbe
keys.0.t: Scipion d Hasdrubal ttwaqeblen deg yiwen wass sɣur Syphax
keys.1.t: igelliden inumidiyen i tezweǧ : Syphax, syen Masinissa
keys.2.t: n wussan gar aṭṭef n Cirta d tmeɣra-ines akked Masinissa
intro.title: Azal n umennuɣ
intro.paras.0: Yelli-s n uqayed Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon, i yineɣlin lɛesker tipunikiyen di Hispania, Sophonisbe tella seg yiwet n twaculin timeqqranin n Qarṭaǧ. Tettwaselmed, tettwassen s lǧamal-is, maca urɛad tella d taḥerɛa kan : tella d azal ameqqran deg umennuɣ.
intro.paras.1: Zzwaǧ-is akked Syphax, agellid n At Masaesyles, mačči d lameɛna n wul maca d lxedma tameqqrant : issuref agellid aneɛɛam di Numidie akked lxiyala-ines ɣer Qarṭaǧ, deg lweqt i deg Ṛuma theggi aṭṭef n Tefriqt.
intro.tags.0: Lsas : axxam n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon
intro.nameText: « Sophonisbe » d talɣa tagrikt akked talatinit n yisem apunik, ahat Ṣapanbaʿal, « Baal iḥerz ».
life.title: Tudert deg umennuɣ
life.rows.0.title: Talalit di Qarṭaǧ
life.rows.0.text: Yelli-s n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon. Akken i d-yeqqaṛ Appien, tella-d yakan tweɛɛed i Masinissa, agellid amecṭuḥ anumidi i yettwarbba di Qarṭaǧ.
life.rows.1.title: Taɣmert tanumidit
life.rows.1.text: Yettwanneɣ di Ilipa, Hasdrubal yeffeɣ seg Hispania. Nețța d Scipion ttwaqeblen deg yiwen wass sɣur Syphax di Siga : yal yiwen yebɣa tadukla tanumidit.
life.rows.2.title: Tagellidt n At Masaesyles
life.rows.2.text: Hasdrubal yefka yelli-s i Syphax, i yeǧǧan tadukla-ines d Ṛuma. Masinissa, yettwakksen seg tgelda-ines, yedduked akked Scipion.
life.rows.3.title: Ṛuma di Tefriqt
life.rows.4.title: Iqamen deg tmes
life.rows.4.text: Scipion isseṛɣ deg yiḍ iqamen n Hasdrubal akked Syphax, syen yeqhheṛ-iten di Grandes Plaines.
life.rows.5.title: Aɣelluy n Cirta
life.rows.5.text: Syphax yettwaṭṭef sɣur Laelius d Masinissa ; Cirta teldi tiwwura-ines. Sophonisbe tḥellel Masinissa akken ur tt-yețțak ara i Iṛumaniyen : izewweǧ yid-s ass-nni direct.
life.rows.6.title: Afran aneggaru
life.rows.6.text: Scipion yessuter-itt-id d lɣella n ugdud aṛumi, i Triyunf. Masinissa, yebḍa wul-is, yazen-as-d lkas n ssem. Tesw-it.
life.rows.7.title: Deffir-s
life.rows.7.text: Hannibal yettwanneɣ di Zama ; Masinissa yuɣal d agellid n Numidie meṛṛa, amdakel n Ṛuma. Syphax yemmut d aḥbis di Italya.
kings.title: Gar sin igelliden
kings.aside: Snat tgeldiwin tinumidiyin ssetqayant ɣef tmurt ; Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ ssetqayant ɣef Yinumidiyen.
kings.items.0.name: Syphax
kings.items.0.text: Agellid aneɛɛam aktar di Numidie, tamanaɣt-is Siga syen Cirta. Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ ssutrent-t, maca yefra ɣer Qarṭaǧ mi izewweǧ Sophonisbe. Yettwanneɣ di 203, yețwawwi d aḥbis ɣer Italya.
kings.items.1.name: Masinissa
kings.items.1.text: Amdakel aqbur n Qarṭaǧ di Hispania, Syphax yekkes-as tagelda-ines, yefra ɣer Ṛuma. Amenɛam akked Laelius, izewweǧ Sophonisbe, syen ilaq-as ad t-yefk i Scipion. Ad igellid armi d 148 uq.Ɛ.
cup.title: Lkas n ssem
cup.paras.0: I Scipion, yelli-s n Hasdrubal, i yekksen Syphax ɣef Ṛuma, telha i ugdud aṛumi : ilaq ad teddu deg Triyunf-is. Masinissa ur izmir ara a tt-isellek, ur izmir ara daɣen ad yagi.
cup.paras.1: Yazen-as ssem s ufus n uqeddac. Sophonisbe teqbel-it am « tikci n tmeɣra » tesw-it war ma tergigi, tefren tamettant wala ssnasel n webrid n Triyunf aṛumi.
cup.caption: Umennuɣ n Zama (202 uq.Ɛ.), aseggas deffir tmettant-is
quote.kicker: Awalen-ines ineggura, akken i d-yeqqaṛ Tite-Live
quote.tr: Qebleɣ tikci-agi n tmeɣra, s lǧamila, ma argaz-iw ur yezmir ara ad as-yefk ayen ifazen i tmeṭṭut-is. Maca ini-as belli ad mmteɣ s lḥurma tugar lemma ur zewǧeɣ ara ass n temdint-iw.
myth.title: Beɛd tiqsiṭ taṛumit
myth.aside: Sophonisbe ur tettwassen ara ala s wawal n yiɛdawen-is.
myth.items.0.title: D « tafettana » ?
myth.items.0.text: Tite-Live isseqqar-d Syphax yellan d aḥbis belli tella d lmeḥna-ines, tin i t-ikksen seg tdukla n Ṛuma. Abeggen n Sophonisbe d tafettana yesellek asefhem n tbeddla n Yinumidiyen. Maca nezmer a nwali deg-s tadiblumasit yefhamen mliḥ, i yessnen belli anɛam n Ṛuma d aɣelluy n Qarṭaǧ.
myth.items.1.title: Yiwen n Ugdil
myth.items.1.text: Tefren lkas n ssem wala ssnasel n Triyunf aṛumi, teḥrez lḥurma n Qarṭaǧ armi d ineffas-ines ineggura — tigawt i d-tesbedd tsekla tureppit abeḥri war ma teḥbes.
sourcesNote.title: Seg wansa i d-tekka tmusni-agi
sourcesNote.items.0.text: Amezruy n Ṛuma : tiqsiṭ tagejdant n tudert-is d tmettant-is, s wawalen-ines ineggura (XXX, 12–15).
sourcesNote.items.1.text: Tamuɣli-nniḍen : Sophonisbe tweɛɛed uqbel i Masinissa, tiddyen n uɣelluy n Cirta.
sourcesNote.items.2.text: Lɣerba tasertant n tdukla tinumidiyin deg umennuɣ apunik wis sin.
sourcesNote.items.3.text: Tiqsiṭ tawezlant mgal-itt, i d-yeqqimen d iḥricen kan.
legacy.title: Taḥerɛa n lmeḥna
legacy.intro: Aɛlam n urgagi apunik, afran-ines aneggaru d lḥurma zdat tneɣruft. Seg Renaissance, tamettant-is tella d yiwen seg isental imeqqranen n tragidya, lopera d tawlaft.
legacy.items.0.text: Sofonisba, yiwet seg tragidyat tamezwarut « iqamen » s tutlayt talyanit.
legacy.items.1.text: La Sophonisbe, tiɣri tameqqrant deg tragidya taklasikt tafransist.
legacy.items.2.text: Sophonisbe, tagellidt i yesɛan lmeɛna n lḥurma-ines ugar n lmeḥbuba-ines.
legacy.items.3.text: The Tragedy of Sophonisba, di Lingliz.
legacy.items.4.text: Sofonisba, lopera i d-yettwaxelqen di Milan ; ad d-yilin Traetta (1762) deffir-s.
legacy.items.5.text: Tura-tt-id ɣer deffir n tmacahutt n Mairet.
legacy.items.6.text: Mattia Preti, Giambattista Pittoni akked waṭas wiyaḍ sewlafen « tamettant n Sophonisbe ».

more.title: Ɣeṛ daɣen
more.items.0.title: Hannibal
more.items.0.text: Ssawlen-as-d seg Italya, inneɣ Scipion d Masinissa di Zama.
more.items.1.title: Imenɣan Ipunikiyen
more.items.1.text: Tlata imenɣan, meyya d tmanya d ɛecra iseggasen : Ṛuma mgal Qarṭaǧ.
more.items.2.title: Akk Tudarin
more.items.2.text: At Barca, iqayden, yibeḥriyen d tgellidin.
